title: Today In Golf
summary: A 30-second briefing on today's biggest golf stories.

items.headline: McIlroy Penalized in Abu Dhabi
items.text: Rory McIlroy received a two-shot penalty for improving his lie on the 12th hole during the first round of the Abu Dhabi Aldar Championship, resulting in a double-bogey 8 and leaving him eight shots behind leader Francesco Laporta's bogey-free 62.

items.headline: Rahm Must Qualify to Return
items.text: Patrick Reed stated that Jon Rahm has to earn his PGA Tour spot through qualification, indicating Rahm does not have an automatic return.
